terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: Mars’s month, the first of the old Roman year, which is why September to December are named seventh to tenth. Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Mārtiae: the 1st, 7th and 15th.

phrases.latin: Mārtis erat prīmus mēnsis, Venerisque secundus
phrases.english: the first month was Mars’s, the second Venus’s (in the old Roman year)

martius.html: De Vaan 366, s.v. Mārs, marks Mārs and Mārtius and derives the vowel from *māwarts, with loss of w between like vowels. Traupman 77 marks it too.
